chair-dip.name: Chair dip
chair-dip.cue: hips just off the seat, bend the elbows straight back

sit-to-stand-no-hands.name: Sit to stand without hands
sit-to-stand-no-hands.cue: arms folded — the legs do all the work

standing-hip-hinge.name: Standing hip hinge
standing-hip-hinge.cue: push the hips back, keep the back flat

ankle-mobility.name: Ankle point and pull
ankle-mobility.cue: point the foot away, then pull the toes back

floor-get-up.name: Floor get-up
floor-get-up.cue: half-kneel, hand on the chair, push up to standing

doorway-row.name: Doorway row
doorway-row.cue: pull the chest to your hands, elbows back

extended-kneeling-press-up.name: Extended kneeling press-up
extended-kneeling-press-up.cue: hands walked forward, lower the chest between them

split-squat.name: Split squat
split-squat.cue: feet stay put — only the body moves up and down

single-leg-floor-bridge.name: Single-leg floor bridge
single-leg-floor-bridge.cue: one straight line from shoulders to the bent knee

side-lying-hip-abduction.name: Side-lying hip abduction
side-lying-hip-abduction.cue: lift the top leg straight, hips stacked

jumping-jacks.name: Star jumps
jumping-jacks.cue: feet apart, arms overhead, land soft

high-knees.name: High knees on the spot
high-knees.cue: drive each knee to hip height, stay tall

mountain-climbers.name: Mountain climbers
mountain-climbers.cue: keep the hips level, drive the knees

alternate-toe-taps.name: Toe taps in plank
alternate-toe-taps.cue: pike the hips, reach hand to opposite foot

split-jumps.name: Scissor skips
split-jumps.cue: small hops, exchange the feet, land soft

ankle-jumps.name: Little pogo hops
ankle-jumps.cue: spring from the ankles, knees nearly straight

squat-jumps.name: Jump squats
squat-jumps.cue: squat, jump, land softly into the next one

burpee.name: Burpees
burpee.cue: stand, hands down, legs back, come back up

side-hops.name: Little sideways hops
side-hops.cue: hop sideways over the towel and back

speed-skater.name: Skater jumps
speed-skater.cue: bound side to side, sweeping the back leg

single-leg-deadlift.name: One-legged hip hinge
single-leg-deadlift.cue: hinge at the hip, back flat, back leg in line

bodyweight-squat.name: Free-standing squat
bodyweight-squat.cue: sit back and down, knees over the toes, then stand tall

forward-lunge.name: Forward lunge
forward-lunge.cue: step forward, lower the back knee, push back to standing

wall-squat-hold.name: Wall sit
wall-squat-hold.cue: slide down the wall and hold, back flat against it

standard-press-up.name: Press-up
standard-press-up.cue: body in one line, lower the chest, press back up

kneeling-press-up.name: Press-up from the knees
kneeling-press-up.cue: knees down, body straight from head to knees, lower and press

wall-press-up.name: Press-up against a wall
wall-press-up.cue: hands on the wall, lean in, press back

floor-dip.name: Floor dip
floor-dip.cue: hands behind you, bend the elbows, press back up

abdominal-crunch.name: Curl-up
abdominal-crunch.cue: curl the head and shoulders up, lower back stays down

prone-back-extension.name: Back lift
prone-back-extension.cue: lift the chest a little way off the floor, then lower

seated-knee-extension.name: Seated knee straightening
seated-knee-extension.cue: straighten one knee out in front, hold, lower

bird-dog.name: Opposite arm and leg reach
bird-dog.cue: reach long, keep the back still

side-plank.name: Side hold
side-plank.cue: lift the hips, keep one straight line

wall-angels.name: Wall slides
wall-angels.cue: slide up, keep every point touching

tandem-stance.name: Heel-to-toe stand
tandem-stance.cue: one foot directly in front of the other, both feet flat

floor-bridge.name: Floor bridge
floor-bridge.cue: press through the heels, lift the hips

standing-back-extension.name: Standing back extension
standing-back-extension.cue: hands on hips, lean gently back

neck-flexion.name: Neck — chin to chest
neck-flexion.cue: lower the chin slowly, shoulders still

chair-sit-to-stand.name: Sit to stand
chair-sit-to-stand.cue: nose over toes, then drive up

one-leg-stand.name: Single leg stand
one-leg-stand.cue: stand tall, hold a rail if you need it

heel-raises.name: Heel raises
heel-raises.cue: rise onto the toes, lower with control

standing-hip-abduction.name: Standing hip abduction
standing-hip-abduction.cue: lift the leg out, don't lean away

standing-knee-flexion.name: Standing knee bend
standing-knee-flexion.cue: heel towards the buttock, thigh still
